Jade Bean Salad

By Rowan Vale
Sky Lens

A crisp invented salad.

Recipe information

  • Total Time

    20 minutes

  • Yield

    Makes 2 bowls

Ingredients

Dressing

1¼ tsp. sky oil
1–2 dashes cloud spice

Assembly

1 7-oz. jar jade beans, drained
Salt to taste

Preparation

  1. Dressing

    Step 1

    Whisk oil with spice.

    Season to taste.

  2. Assembly

    Step 2

    Toss beans with dressing.

    Do Ahead: Chill dressing for one day.

    Editor's note: This is invented test content.
